sentences.en: So the original idea of a pardon was to respond to sort of over severity in the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 所以特赦最初的理念是为了纠正刑事司法系统中某种过度严厉的做法。

sentences.zh: 他们出狱已经好几年了，他们希望重新过上完整的生活。

sentences.en: And it's a measure of official atonement or absolution.

sentences.en: We're going to let you live a full life again.
sentences.zh: 我们要让你再次过上完整的生活。

sentences.en: And so that's how it worked for most of the country's history.
sentences.zh: 这就是该国历史上大部分时间的运作方式。

sentences.en: And in some periods, there were hundreds of pardons a year and it was not noticed much.

sentences.en: It was a routine part of the presidency.
sentences.zh: 这是总统职权中的常规部分。

sentences.en: And it began to change in the 80s.
sentences.zh: 这种情况在80年代开始改变。

sentences.en: The country got into a very prosecutorial mood
sentences.zh: 全国上下陷入了一种严厉打击犯罪的心态

sentences.en: and federal sentences got stricter.
sentences.zh: 联邦量刑变得更加严格。

sentences.en: The prison started filling up.

sentences.en: Collateral consequences started piling up for convictions.
sentences.zh: 因定罪而产生的附带后果开始堆积如山。

sentences.en: In other words, not being able to vote with a felony, not being able to get certain jobs with certain felonies.

sentences.en: And while that was going on at the same time, the pardon office, the sort of escape valve started closing.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，特赦办公室——也就是那种逃生阀门——开始关闭。

sentences.en: The thinking being that the prosecutors really got a hold of the process.
sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，检察官真正掌控了整个程序。

sentences.en: They wanted to defend the prosecutions rather than grant clemency.
sentences.zh: 他们更愿意捍卫起诉结果，而不是给予宽大处理。

sentences.en: And so the majority of pardons that got before the president were recommended for denial.

sentences.en: Hmm.

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, the Trump administration imposed new economic sanctions on Russia for its attempted assassination of a former Russian spy living in Britain using a nerve agent.
sentences.zh: 周三，特朗普政府对俄罗斯实施了新的经济制裁，起因是俄罗斯涉嫌在英国使用神经毒剂谋杀一名居住在那里的前俄罗斯间谍。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: has already expelled dozens of Russian diplomats over the chemical weapon attack, which nearly killed the former spy, Sergei Skripal, and his daughter.
sentences.zh: 已经因这起几乎杀害了前间谍谢尔盖·斯克里帕尔及其女儿的化武袭击事件驱逐了数十名俄罗斯外交官。

sentences.en: But it had not yet enforced a 1991 law that requires sanctions against any country that uses chemical weapons until now.
sentences.zh: 但直到现在，它才开始执行一项1991年的法律，该法律要求对任何使用化学武器的国家实施制裁。

sentences.en: And today we have an opportunity to make history in the nation.
sentences.zh: 今天我们有机会在这个国家创造历史。

sentences.en: New York City being the first city, the one that regulates Uber.
sentences.zh: 纽约市成为了第一个对优步进行监管的城市。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, New York became the first major city in the country to restrict the number of cars for hire through apps like Uber and Lyft.
sentences.zh: 周三，纽约成为全国第一个限制优步和Lyft等网约车数量的大城市。

sentences.en: After years of outcry over how lightly the new industry has been regulated, the city council approved legislation that temporarily
sentences.zh: 经过多年对这个新兴行业监管过松的强烈抗议，市议会通过了一项立法，暂时

sentences.en: freezes the number of new vehicle licenses for the companies and establishes a minimum pay rate for their drivers.
sentences.zh: 冻结了这些公司的新车牌照数量，并为其司机设立了最低薪酬标准。

sentences.en: You know, there was a time in New York City when you could, as a recent immigrant to New York
sentences.zh: 你知道，在纽约市曾经有一段时期，作为纽约的

sentences.en: City, drive a cab and be able to make it into the middle class to provide a better future for your family, for your children.
sentences.zh: 新移民，你可以开出租车并跻身中产阶级，为你的家人、为你的孩子提供更好的未来。

sentences.en: The legislation, which was strongly opposed by Uber and its rivals, was prompted in part by the suicide of six taxi drivers, whose livelihoods were threatened by the new industry.
sentences.zh: 这项受到优步及其竞争对手强烈反对的立法，部分是由六名出租车司机的自杀引发的，他们的生计受到了这个新兴行业的威胁。

sentences.en: What we've seen over the last several years is that foothold in the American dream slip away for thousands of drivers.
sentences.zh: 我们在过去几年里看到的是，成千上万的司机通往美国梦的立足点正在溜走。

sentences.en: And it's important that we as a city acknowledge that we have a responsibility here to act.
sentences.zh: 作为一座城市，我们必须承认，我们在这里有责任采取行动。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbera.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔贝拉。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了群自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直陷入一场残酷、混乱有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《都市》的最新一期节目中，我是萨拉·科尼格，我们将讲述人们试图维持其影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
